proposal.summary: R3 is the CM550 rows whose old Calterm-slug names contain anc / rsg / afc / pto / accel / decel. The ANC (acceleration noise control) rows are the e2m 10A5 calibration block and 10A4 status block of three CM550-only limits that run every 50 ms: fuel 0xb2aa, timing 0xb3d0 and engine speed 0xb4f2 (CM848 compiles this stage out). Each limit engages while the first stage engine acceleration is at or below a maximum, the second stage is at or above a minimum, and an engine speed or coolant condition holds. After a bare engine acceleration it is inhibited for a calibrated duration. Once engaged it is held on for a minimum time, and it ramps back out when released. The alpha / AFC rows are the same records as CM848's in the twin calculateAlphaAirFuelControlResult. The cruise, road speed governor and power take-off engagement calibrations have no code in the dumped ROM, so they take CM848's names for the same e2m records, and the A/C and vehicle acceleration rows are named from their records. Several old names were wrong: three anc / ac byte rows are auxiliary driver recovery counters of updateEngineSyncStatus, three anc_altitude rows are the sync pulse thresholds and ring pointer of cm550_detectEngineSpeedSensorSyncPulse, and the four eps_accel rows are words inside the PPCVTB fueling curve table.

roles.role: It is not a counter but a 0/1 latch in mc68k_sampleAndDebounceDiscreteInputs. It is cleared while the PTO on bit (0x80bcd5 bit 4) is off (0x1543c) and set to 1 when the word 0x80aa02 equals 3 (0x1544c). While it is 0, set + resume pressed together set the PTO set-and-resume bit PTSERUSW (0x20) and clear 0x80bcd4 bit 6, and set or resume alone clears 0x80bcd4 bit 6. While it is 1, both effects are blocked. Type word. It is skipped because the latch's trigger 0x80aa02 (e2m 117D +3E) has no record in any CM550-family e2m and no writer in the dumped ROM, so what state 3 means is unknown.
roles.discriminator: Its effect is clear but its trigger is unknown.

roles.role: Hold pass count of the PTO set switch in mc68k_sampleAndDebounceDiscreteInputs. It counts +1 per pass while 0x80bcd5 bit 2 (set) is on and saturates at 25 (0x19). ANC: three limit functions with one pattern, compares checked in the disassembly. 0xb2aa (now cm550_rpm_system_state_controller) is the ANC fuel limit calculation, 0xb3d0 the timing limit, and 0xb4f2 (now cm550_engineStateFuelLimitInterpolator) the engine speed limit. 0xb666 (cm550_initFuelSystemOutputDriver) is the ANC start-up: ASANENF = 1 and NZESLM = the maximum rated speed. 0xb614 / 0xb63e are the fuel / timing lookup set-ups. CM848 has the 10A4 records but no ANC code. NZESTRES 0x807a34 is used as an engine speed ceiling, the opposite of its Calterm text.

AFC: 0xc180 (cm550_fuelTimingTransitionStateMachine) is the AFC fuel limit calculation, counterpart of cm848_calculateAirFuelControlFuelLimit. 0xc2be sets the AFC timing increment and the FLAFSTFG latch. 0xc658 clears both alpha latches.

PTO: 0x2dcb0 (cm550_oil_pressure_shutdown_controller) is the PTO / user fueling selector. It is a counterpart, not a twin, of cm848_selectPowerTakeOffOrUserFueling, because the mode lists differ.

Misnamed rows: 0x800152-0x800176 is the auxiliary driver read-back block of updateEngineSyncStatus (0xd610, eight drivers written out inline). cm550_clearKickdownControlState (0xe780) clears it. Its CM848 counterpart is cm848_monitorDiscreteOutputReadBack / cm848_checkDiscreteOutputReadBack. CM550's old sibling names (high_side / low_side) invert CM848's high / low fault meaning. 0x8001a0-0x8001ac is the engine speed sensor sync pulse detector, not ANC altitude. 0x10394 (cm550_canBusTimingInit) presets its thresholds.

Skipped: 0x8001a6 (the low word of the dword 0x8001a4), 0x80053e (its trigger 0x80aa02 = 117D +3E has no record and no writer), and 0x8087f0 / f2 / fa / fc (cells of the 12DF PPCVTB table at 0x8086f2).

No code in the dumped ROM reads: A/C 818A / 818B, vehicle acceleration 818C, cruise / RSG 1186 / 1187 / 1197, drivetrain ratio 106C / 106D, PTO 109D, or NZTAACLM. Those names come from the records, plus the CM848 rows of the same records where they exist.

Type changes: undefined -> word for 0x80003c, 0x80003e, 0x800042, 0x800046, 0x80a912. 0x8001a4 undefined -> dword. 0x8001ac undefined -> dword *. 0x807a4c undefined -> i16. 0x80de68 word -> i16.

Siblings outside this batch that follow the same pattern: 0x800540 / 0x800542 are the cruise set / resume hold counts, 0x8001a8 / 0x8001b0 / 0x8001b4 are the latest period, ring start and ring last entry, and 0x80bcde holds the cruise switch override values.

verdict.overall: 74 CM550 global verdicts: 71 CONFIRMED, 3 AMENDED, none REFUTED. All 74 names are unique in CM550's global_variables.csv and function_renames.csv and among the proposals (judge/check_unique.py). I re-derived every row from the disassembly. The ANC rows come from 0xb2aa (fuel limit), 0xb3d0 (timing limit), 0xb4f2 (engine speed limit), 0xb210, 0xb4ce and 0xb666. The others come from updateEngineSyncStatus, the sync pulse detector 0x1025c (one caller at 0x1a988, which runs before the new period is stored at 0x1a9e8), mc68k_sampleAndDebounceDiscreteInputs (a4 = 0x80bcce, a5 = 0x80bcd4), the AFC / alpha code (0xc180, 0xc2be, 0xc2ee, 0xc326, 0xc504) and the PTO / user fueling selector 0x2dcb0. Where no code reads a row, I checked find_range_refs over the whole block: only parameter_id_table entries point into the A/C, vehicle acceleration, cruise / RSG, drivetrain ratio, 109D PTO and 1197 blocks, and into NZTAACLM. Every CM848 reuse is the same record (same block, offset and description, or the same mnemonic in the twin), and its CM848 row exists. The three amendments: 0x807a00 / 0x807a02 become air_conditioning_vehicle_acceleration_cutout_threshold / _cutout_duration, after CM848's A/C cutout family air_conditioning_<trigger>_cutout_*; the proposed 0x807a00 name reads as a threshold for disabling vehicle acceleration. 0x80dc30 becomes power_take_off_or_user_fueling, to pair with power_take_off_or_user_fueling_state the way final_fueling, requested_fueling and adjusted_user_fueling pair with their _state rows. All six skips should stay skipped. 0x8001a6 has no reference; it is the low word of the dword 0x8001a4, so its row must be deleted in the same change that types 0x8001a4 as dword, or the rows overlap. 0x80053e is a 0/1 latch whose trigger (0x80aa02 == 3, 117D +3E) has no v64t6_s record and no writer in the dump; other e2m families put unrelated records at 117D +3E. 0x8087f0 / f2 / fa / fc are cells of the PPCVTB fueling curve table, proven from the RAM dump: X byte count 20 at 0x8086b0, Y byte count 42 at 0x8086c6, 10 x 21 = 210 words over 0x8086f2-0x808895, next block 12D4 at 0x808896, and only the parameter_id_table references it. The investigator's function leads (renames of 0xb2aa, 0xb4f2, 0xb666, 0x10394, 0x2dcb0 and updateEngineSyncStatus) are consistent with what I read, but this batch has no function verdicts.
